name: dayz-n-chill
description: DayZ n' Chill's plugin marketplace. Currently hosts Agentic-Z (AI agent stack for DayZ modding); future DayZ-modding plugins from the same org will land here too.

plugins.name: agentic-z
plugins.description: AI agent stack for DayZ modding. After install, run /dayz-init for a guided setup wizard that takes you from empty repo to mod-loaded-in-DayZ. Ships specialist subagents and DayZ slash skills covering the full mod pipeline (preflight, scaffold, build PBO, launch test, types.xml, RAG indexers), plus the dayz-rag MCP server for semantic search over vanilla Enforce Script and the Bohemia community wiki.
